label: LaTeX and word processing — unseen mastery test

items.stem: Which file is the editable LaTeX source?
items.explanation: A .tex file contains the editable LaTeX source.

items.stem: Which command selects the document class?
items.explanation: documentclass selects the document class.

items.stem: Which command creates a section heading?
items.explanation: section creates a structured heading.

items.stem: Which delimiters are commonly used for inline math?
items.explanation: Parenthesised delimiters place mathematics within text.

items.stem: Which command creates a fraction?
items.explanation: frac takes numerator and denominator arguments.

items.stem: Which word-processor feature records edits?
items.explanation: Track Changes records revisions.

items.stem: Where are package declarations usually placed?
items.explanation: Packages are generally loaded in the preamble before document content.

items.stem: Which is the correct environment pattern?
items.explanation: LaTeX environments are delimited by begin and end commands.

items.stem: Which output is commonly produced by compiling LaTeX?
items.explanation: PDF is a common typeset output.

items.stem: Which feature can generate a table of contents from headings?
items.explanation: Heading styles provide structure used by automatic contents tools.

items.stem: Which math mode suits a standalone equation?
items.explanation: Display math sets an equation apart from the text.

items.stem: What is the role of a citation manager?
items.explanation: Citation managers store reference metadata and format citations.

items.stem: How many brace pairs are used in \frac{a}{b} to enclose its two arguments?
items.explanation: There is one brace pair around the numerator and one around the denominator.

items.stem: A document has 5 sections and 3 subsections in each. How many subsections total?
items.explanation: 5×3=15. Each of the five sections contains three subsection headings.

items.stem: If a document has 12 pages and page numbering starts at 1, what is the last page number?
items.explanation: The twelfth page is numbered 12.

items.stem: How many commands delimit a basic document body: begin and end?
items.explanation: One begin and one end command delimit the document environment.

items.stem: A document has 4 main sections, each with 2 subsections. How many subsection headings?
items.explanation: 4×2=8. Each main section contributes two subsection headings.

items.stem: Which choice best supports reproducible mathematical typesetting?
options: Only a screenshot of the final page
Retain LaTeX source and compile it
items.explanation: Retaining source permits revision and recompilation.
